subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Should OpenClaw core own a built-in Gateway watchdog and automatic recovery model, and which recovery actions should be default, opt-in, or out of scope?
rationale: The request would add core recovery semantics, configuration, notification, doctor/repair behavior, and degraded startup policy; source inspection can prove the gap but cannot choose the security and operator-control boundary.

options.title: Keep design umbrella
options.body: Use this issue to settle the core recovery policy, then land narrower PRs for watchdog, crash-loop ladder, health schema, doctor integration, and startup mode only after the boundary is approved.

options.title: Close into narrower trackers
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79165 and related items the canonical trackers only after every remaining slice from this broader issue has an explicit owner and linked scope.

options.title: Keep recovery external
options.body: Document supervisor/plugin/ClawHub watchdog patterns and reject core automatic recovery beyond existing diagnostics and safe-mode mechanisms.

recommendation.title: Keep design umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle the core recovery policy, then land narrower PRs for watchdog, crash-loop ladder, health schema, doctor integration, and startup mode only after the boundary is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior related reviews route the broad Gateway health/restart/doctor product boundary to this person, and they are the most repeated current follow-up candidate in the issue history.
